dedupe_keys.name: dados hidraulicos por reservatorio base diaria

description: ONS consolidates verified daily hydraulic observations for reservoirs. The dictionary provides upstream and downstream levels, checked useful-storage percentages, inflow, turbine flow, spill and other water-balance terms, alongside plant identifiers and cascade order. These variables support water-balance and hydropower-operation modelling. This checked daily product differs from the unverified hourly agent feed. The portal describes updates at 09:15, 14:15 and 17:00; observations can still be revised. Coverage is individual reservoirs in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV, Excel and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.
